reviews.t: Wonderful for seniors between  dental appointments
reviews.x: As a senior citizen, I know how difficult it can be to maintain good dental health.  I purchased this product on the advise of my dentist and I couldn't be happier.  I tried it as soon as I received it and it removed stains and left my teeth looking white.  Makes your teeth feel like you just left the dentist office.  I am using it every day and it works great.  My husband loves it as well.  He has been using whitening trays and this works better.

Was looking for something to get the plaque between my teeth it seems to build up faster there I found it this works great it’s so easy to use. Also comes with an extra pick and mirror so you can get hard to reach places. Definitely recommend.

reviews.t: Weaken the calculus and get your stable hands ready
reviews.x: This came in a few hours ago. I'm thrilled by the results. Here's what I did -- softened the calculus and then broke it up. 1. Flossed 2. Rinsed with Mouthwash. 3. Brushed thoroughly with baking soda toothpaste (A&H). 4. Used this device to break up the calculus.  Had high hopes and strong doubts, but was willing to try. Glad I went by the picture reviews. I purchased this item due to the dentist recommending getting a device that could remove plaque from the teeth in between cleanings.  I tried it at first on low setting so I could get used to the sensation.  Slowly I increased the intensity which seem to actually be more effective especially on the back of my lower teeth where most build up occurs.  I would recommend this device to anyone looking to take better care of their teeth between cleanings.

I wanted to try something that would chip away at my tartar buildup. I've had it for years, but can't afford to go to the dentist. The first session was only using the scrubber. It didn't do much. The second session, however, I used the provided pick to crack the tartar. After a few pieces were taken out, I used the scrubber and all that tartar just fell off. You should use the whole cleaning package for the best results.
This product is AMAZING! Removed my stubborn stains and plaque in a few minutes, I am so freaking happy I bought this, please do yourself a favor and but it RIGHT NOW!

Wow! Please be careful with this. I did as instructed at 45 degree angle and this left a grayish stain/mark on my tooth. I will post pics of my tooth once I get a good close up. If you have sensitive or fragile teeth, In my humble opinion, I do not recommend. Be extra careful.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the device effectively removes plaque, tartar, and stains, often with immediate or fast results.
Reviewers frequently describe the device as easy to use.
Some reviewers note it works best when combined with other tools or techniques, such as a pick or softening the calculus first.
A few reviewers report the device did not work for them at all.
One reviewer found it powerful and light but difficult to reach inside spots.
